information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak # Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us. Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made via the email address you provided when you set up your WCA account. Registrations have to be approved *manually.* Please allow up to 48 hrs for your name to appear on the competitor's list. **SCHEDULE CHANGES** If time permits, an additional round of 4x4 will be added. *Please note that the schedule is subject to change. We resereve the right to alter the schedule in any way. We may alter the number of competitors proceeding to the next round. We may eliminate a round altogether. This all depends on if we run ahead or behind of the planned schedule.*
